items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Ronnie Zito with me today

ctx.x: Ronnie was interviewed via Zoom on March 9, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive, and Rick Montalbano, longtime friend of Ronnie and a previous interviewee of the Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Ronnie Zito with me today along with my good pal Rick Montalbano. We are in three different places, musically I like to think we’re closer together.
